sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् । होतारं रत्नधातमम् ॥
transliteration: agnim īḷe purohitaṁ yajñasya devam ṛtvijam | hotāraṁ ratnadhātamam ||
translation: I praise Agni, the household priest, the divine minister of sacrifice, the invoker, best bestower of treasures.

sanskrit: अग्निः पूर्वेभिरृषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत । स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
transliteration: agniḥ pūrvebhir ṛṣibhir īḍyo nūtanair uta | sa devām̐ eha vakṣati ||
translation: Worthy is Agni to be praised by ancient seers and by present ones; may he bring the gods here.
